card.summary: 5 GB storage per free site, with unlimited topics, chat and members

free_tier.stated: 5 GB storage per free site, with unlimited topics, chat and members

egress.terms: Free; uploads served from *.discourse-cdn.com behind CloudFront, so a Cloudflare/CloudFront cache sits in front already

record.tooling: Discourse's own REST API is fully available on the free site (POST /uploads.json with an API key, /posts.json, /latest.json); no rclone backend
record.chaining: 5 GB x N free sites. Free sites are self-serve from id.discourse.com/create-site with a Discourse ID; provisioning is rate-limited but per-hour, not per-account. 100 sites = 500 GB; 400 sites = 2 TB.
record.limits_note: 5 GB per site; 2 staff seats; 10 categories; no tags; no private categories; site provisioning throttled ('You have provisioned too many sites in the past hour'); post/upload rate limits are default Discourse
record.reliability_note: Free plan launched 2026-02 and is still labelled beta; the provisioning throttle is the real scaling brake, and the 10-category cap makes bulk-upload workflows awkward.

evidence.proved: 'Unlimited topics, chat and members... 2 staff seats, 5GB storage'
'A real Discourse, free forever... No credit card - Unlimited members - Set up in about 1 minute'
probe: GET -> HTTP 200 application/json (public read API works anonymously); POST https://meta.discourse.org/uploads.json -> HTTP 403 (write path auth-gated as expected)
probe: GET ... -> 302 -> 200 via CloudFront (uploads are CDN-fronted)
